Task: Add test methods to Lib/test/test_configparser.py for copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, and pickle round-trips of a parser-raised MultilineContinuationError. Two inputs: with/without final newline. Verify restored: class, args, source, lineno, line, errors, message.

Key facts:
- ExceptionPicklingTestCase at ~line 1697 has existing pickle tests (test_error, test_nosectionerror, etc.)
- test_multilinecontinuationerror at line 1852 triggers the error with: ConfigParser(allow_no_value=True).read_string('[section]\noption\n    continuation', source='test.cfg')
- MultilineContinuationError(source,lineno,line): ParsingError.__init__ sets source,errors=[],args=(source,); append adds to errors/message, sets lineno,line,args
- Need to see lines 1761-1852 for full structure before editing.
